name: Dimension Pendulum-Duel
descriptionTemplate:
{Awaken}: After unleashing Exalt for the first time each turn, reset that Awakener's Exalt cooldown and grant them 50 Aliemus, generating temporary copies of all "Skills" with an Arithmetica Cost of 0.
{Seal}: After unleashing Exalt for the first time each turn, seal other Awakeners.
